BJP Announces Candidates for Jaipur Municipal Corporation Elections

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has announced its list of candidates for the Jaipur Municipal Corporation elections. The list includes candidates for various wards. Notably, former mayor Jyoti Khandelwal is among the candidates, and the list also features eight Muslim candidates.
